reconstructed_captions.21: A close-up of the finished, polished stone axe head lying on the ground.
reconstructed_captions.22: The man picks up the axe head and walks towards a fallen log.
reconstructed_captions.23: He examines the log, choosing a spot to work on.
reconstructed_captions.24: He positions the log over a large, flat-topped tree stump to use as a workbench.
reconstructed_captions.25: He kneels beside the log and stump, preparing to work.
reconstructed_captions.26: He firmly grips the stone axe head in his hand, ready to strike.
reconstructed_captions.27: He swings the axe head and strikes the log, making the first cut.
reconstructed_captions.28: He continues to strike the log in the same place, creating a small notch.
reconstructed_captions.29: Wood chips fly from the log with each impact of the stone tool.
reconstructed_captions.30: He methodically chops at the log, deepening the notch with each swing.
reconstructed_captions.31: A close-up shot shows the sharp stone edge cutting into the wood fibers.
reconstructed_captions.32: He continues the rhythmic chopping, his movements efficient and practiced.
reconstructed_captions.33: He pauses briefly to clear away wood chips from the notch.
reconstructed_captions.34: He resumes chopping, striking the log with consistent force.
reconstructed_captions.35: The man continues to repeatedly strike the log with the stone axe head.
